entities.name: PMID:25079219
observations: Primary study reports that BIX01294 inhibition of EHMT1/EHMT2 enhances IFNα2a cytotoxicity in K562, KCL22, BV173, and KT1 CML cell lines.
BIX01294 augments IFNα2a-mediated apoptosis; reduced H3K9me2 at interferon-stimulated gene promoters supports enhanced type I interferon response.

entities.name: Chronic myeloid leukemia
observations: The study tested CML cell lines K562, KCL22, BV173, and KT1.

entities.name: EHMT1
observations: EHMT1 is targeted by BIX01294 in the CML/interferon sensitization study.

entities.name: EHMT2
observations: EHMT2 is targeted by BIX01294 in the CML/interferon sensitization study.

entities.name: BIX01294
observations: EHMT1/EHMT2-specific chemical inhibition with BIX01294 enhanced IFNα2a cytotoxicity and apoptosis in four CML cell lines.

entities.name: IFNα2a
observations: Type I interferon treatment whose cytotoxicity and apoptosis were enhanced by BIX01294 in CML cell lines.

entities.name: EHMT inhibition sensitizes CML
observations: In vitro, BIX01294 increased IFNα2a cytotoxicity in K562, KCL22, BV173, and KT1 cells.
Mechanistically, BIX01294 reduced H3K9me2 at interferon-stimulated gene promoters, enhancing type I interferon response.
